name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Add an automatic prompt review step before every major task. It costs 5-10 seconds per run but catches vague or conflicting instructions early, saving minutes of rework. The trade-off is slower starts for tasks, but the quality gain outweighs it.

name: Gauge
text: The 5-10 second delay is a real tax on flow, and "major tasks" is vague—what’s the threshold? A better alternative: bake prompt review into the *task definition phase* (e.g., when the lead writes the ticket), not the execution phase. Settle it by measuring rework hours saved vs. total task time over two weeks; if the ratio isn’t >3:1, drop it.
